summary: This brief reads the fact layer generated at 2026-11-12T11:37:35Z, which is 06:37 ET and 173 minutes before the US open, so the vantage is pre-market and the overnight Asia and Europe sessions are in scope. The total risk score is 65.92, still high_risk, up 3.70 from 62.22 on the 2026-11-11 row, and the regime label moved from risk_on to late_cycle with confidence at 0.9395. Almost all of that 3.70 comes from cross_asset: production confirmations went from 3 to 5 of the 8, the dimension rose from 37.50 to 62.50 and contributed 3.750, while the other five dimensions together moved only 0.047. The count changed on exactly two quote legs: bitcoin went from 1.1122 to down 1.20643 and copper from 0.8441 to down 1.1077, and both are 24 hour or intraday quotes rather than settled US prices. None of those pre-market reads is in the fact layer, where the NVDA 2.8658 is the 2026-11-11 close. The China A-share close on 2026-11-12 weakened: 4 of 11 names rose and 7 fell, mean down 0.2349 and median down 1.1053, a one session reversal of the 5.0545 gain on 2026-11-11. Three vintages must be flagged: rates and credit stop at 2026-11-09 and the dollar index at 2026-11-06, while memory at down 0.4151, consumer_electronics at down 0.6126 and robotics at down 0.9112 are mixed baskets whose last step lands on the 2026-11-12 Asia session with only 2/8, 2/10 and 1/9 legs present, so none of the three is a US read; crypto is a 24 hour quote.

bull_case.title: Bull case: the board keeps Huang and the semiconductor complex holds its gain
points: Nvidia's board does not act before the investigation closes, the pre-market decline converges after the open, and the 11.8865 gain in MU and 7.3155 in AMD is not given back.
semis at 6.5139 and semiconductor equipment at 6.1801 extend, and semiconductor relative strength starts repairing from down 13.0273.
A soft PPI lets the 10 year real rate ease from 2.66 and releases part of the 4.9075 macro contribution.

base_case.title: Base case: both late_cycle limbs stay marginal and the score oscillates between 62 and 67
points: Confirmations stay at 5/8 and cross-asset holds near 62.50, so the late_cycle label persists alongside the high_risk one.
Rates and credit stay at their 2026-11-09 reads and the 40 points of combined weight keep anchoring 74.58 and 74.21.
The 2.3908 mean across the 22 rows fades toward 1, the index level turns sideways and the pre-market gap is absorbed without starting a trend.

bear_case.title: Bear case: the ouster lands and breadth fails, pushing the score back above 69
points: The board removes Huang, NVDA breaks the 2026-11-11 close, the Nasdaq 100 futures decline carries into cash and the semiconductor complex gives back its gain.
Breadth falls from 0.3806 through 0.35, the risk_off branch re-arms and that alone is enough to put the score back above 69.
HY OAS widens from 3.34, lifting both the liquidity and credit dimension and the cross-asset confirmation count, 35 points of weight between them.
